game-vehicles: sample prototypes of the engine's own tests; the real fleet is guarded in game-vehicles-fleet and game-vehicles-three
game-shapes-three: the guard itself (coincidentFacesOf); it draws no catalog
game-graphics-three: post-processing and quality presets, no pieces
game-destruction-three: renders holes, cracks and debris at run time; decals use polygonOffset, fragments are random rubble
game-vfx-three: sprites, particles and flashes, transparent and without depth write
game-weather-three: rain, fog and sky layers, transparent and without depth write
game-fluids-three: liquid films and stains, drawn with polygonOffset over their surface
game-crowd-three: instanced bodies of game-characters-three, which is guarded
